0022600102.text: The Clippers (1-0, 1st in the Pacific, 2nd in the West) visit the Lakers (1-0, 2nd in the Pacific, 4th in the West) in a regular season matchup, with both teams having won their first game. The Clippers will be without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), all listed as out, while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and have Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, with the most recent a 125-122 Clippers loss in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026.
